conditions: An explicit dependency map and compatible unchanged evidence bindings are available.
construction: Recheck affected obligations; carry unchanged evidence with its original scope and date.
description: Reuse unchanged evidence with its original scope.
example: A parser-only repair reruns malformed/valid input controls; unchanged proof evidence remains historical rather than becoming a fresh Lean run.

lesson.applicability: Incremental Adversary repair reviews and generated next-worker briefs.
lesson.cause: Candidate-wide labels hid the evidence dependency boundary and execution date.
lesson.correction: Identify the exact dependencies of each finding/check. Reuse only unchanged compatible evidence at its original scope and date, then check changed or still-open obligations.
lesson.counterexample: The parser repair reran changed public-entry controls while explicitly retaining the earlier algebraic/Lean evidence for unchanged sources.
lesson.evidence_excerpt: Unchanged algebraic sources were not recompiled or exhaustively re-enumerated merely for this parser repair.
lesson.exceptions: Changes to assumptions, resources, policy, checker or toolchain may invalidate reuse even when a manuscript is unchanged. If the dependency mapping is unavailable, retain UNKNOWN.
lesson.failed_claim: Every candidate edit either invalidates all prior evidence or permits old checks to be called fresh.
lesson.verification: Read Round 2 code and math reviews and their predecessor hash/scope declarations. This digest does not independently rehash the old external candidate or reissue its test results.
